title: Commercial Evidence Traceability
requirement: Every commercially significant value or decision must be capable of tracing to source evidence source revision/version and a precise source location where applicable.

title: Bounded Business Actions
requirement: Every business mutation must be represented as a bounded domain/service action with server-side validation and authority checks; future agents must never depend on arbitrary database writes.

title: Canonical Commercial Balance Derivation
requirement: Each derived commercial/financial balance in V1 must have exactly one canonical derivation over defined financial/commercial events.
verification_method: Ledger formula audit and golden threads
